head.description: Effects for all system tray icons (xapp-status and legacy systray)

desaturation.tooltip: 0% keeps the original colors, 100% makes the icons fully grey

brightness.tooltip: Negative values make the icons darker, positive values make them lighter

contrast.tooltip: Negative values decrease contrast, positive values increase it

color-on-hover.tooltip: Remove all effects from an icon while the pointer is over it
